body: Quarterly loop. (1) Ingest: run tools/nse_fetch.py and bse_fetch.py for announcements (daily, all companies by date), transcripts, results, shareholding, pledge, SAST, PIT and bulk/block deals; save PDFs and pdftotext them. (2) Extract: an LLM fills promise records and a topic/KPI list per call, and diffs annual reports and calls against the prior ones (Lazy Prices). (3) Resolve: when results arrive, mark promises delivered/missed/moved and update the Management Credibility Score. (4) Change detectors: promoter pledge up, promoter SAST sale, PIT sell clusters, auditor/CFO exit, rating watch-negative or 'issuer not cooperating', bulk deals by known operators versus quality funds, related-party approvals in AGM notices, sudden length/complexity rise, dropped KPIs. (5) Human: each flagged company gets one decisive scuttlebutt question, Buffett-AmEx style ('is the moat damaged?', 'is capacity really commissioned?'), answered with dealer, customer and supplier calls, plant visits, pollution-board consent-to-operate records and job postings. (6) Write back: every result becomes a memdb record with a date and sources. The edge is breadth, consistency and memory over years across about 1,000+ small caps that sell-side does not cover, not any single clever signal.
title: Lynch-at-scale pipeline: AI reads every filing, human does scuttlebutt
